SELECT o.fulfilment_type, o.status, o.login_state, count(*) orders, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) dist, sum(order_total_gross) total, min(order_ts_utc), max(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-21 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-02-24 00:00:00'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH l AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_rl,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE sale_date <> CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)) date_ne_utc,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=l.receipt_id WHERE l.sale_date <> CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE)) date_ne_order,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02) vat_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE staff_purchase_flag) staff,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE etl_loaded_at IS NULL) noetl,
 (SELECT min(etl_loaded_at) FROM l) mn, (SELECT max(etl_loaded_at) FROM l) mx,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order o WHERE line_count <> (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line s WHERE s.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) AND status IN ('delivered','collected') AND CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22') linecnt_bad

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
 round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS click_and_collect_share_pct,
 sum(CASE WHEN o.fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) cc_net, sum(f.net_amount) web_net,
 round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN f.receipt_id END)/count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id),2) cc_order_share
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10)
GROUP BY ROLLUP (d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1,2
